properties.description: After a write action, force verification against reality: confirm the new revision is healthy and that a real request now succeeds before claiming the incident is mitigated.

hook.prompt:
A write action just completed. A successful command is not the same as a fixed service. Before you report progress, verify and record:

1. The resulting state read back from Azure (new revision name, health state, running state, applied CPU/memory).
2. A functional check — issue a request against the endpoint that was failing and report the actual status code.
3. The current error rate compared to the pre-incident baseline.

If any of the three is not yet confirmed, say the change is APPLIED BUT UNVERIFIED. Only use the word 'mitigated' once all three pass.
